locked_conventions.physical_interval: [-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with L=2*log(lambda), Lebesgue measure, and zero extension
locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension
locked_conventions.finite_fourier_phase: the factor (-1)^k is retained in coefficients and distributional jump transforms
locked_conventions.source_normalization: source-limit normalization is retained; unit normalization is rejected
locked_conventions.prime_block_sign: minus, as in source equation (3.19), before any norm is taken
locked_conventions.minus_family_precondition: I_2 is nonzero before defining c_n^- or the separated mixed bridge

locked_formulas.mobius_right_inverse: R_lambda g(x)=sum_(n<=lambda/x) mu(n)*g(n*x)/sqrt(n*x), extended evenly with central-hole constant -lambda*J_g
locked_formulas.mixed_bridge_gram: D_sep=[[I+u*u^*,beta*u,0],[beta*u^*,1+beta^2,a^*],[0,a,I+a*a^*]]; the beta*u cross block is retained
locked_formulas.trace_stop: an outward-certified U_M>=tr(E_M) with U_M<1/(8*lambda^2) implies ||I-T*P_F*B||<1/4
locked_formulas.trace_stopping_algorithm: at stage s use M=s and an outward interval for tr(E_s) of width at most 2^(-s); halt only on U_s<1/(8*lambda^2), without assuming rounded monotonicity
locked_formulas.bv_variation_basis: q_a(u)=g_a(u)/sqrt(u), J_a=sum_(n<=K) mu(n)/n*integral_(n/lambda)^lambda q_a(u)du, V_a=2*sqrt(lambda)*(sum_(n<=K)|mu(n)|*integral_(n/lambda)^lambda|q_a'(u)|du+(sum_(n<=K)|mu(n)|)*|q_a(lambda)|+|sum_(n<=K)mu(n)*q_a(n/lambda)+lambda*J_a|), K=floor(lambda^2), and V_(lambda,Y)=(sum_a V_a^2)^(1/2)
locked_formulas.bv_terminal_majorant: for d=dim(Y)>=1, delta=1/(4*sqrt(d)*lambda), rho=1 if V=0 and otherwise min(1,delta^2/(4*kappa_lambda^2*V^2)), R=(4*kappa_lambda^2/delta^2)*(V^2/(2*rho)+c^2*A_lambda^2), and M_BV=max(1,ceil(sqrt(R)/2)); then tr(E_(M_BV))<=1/(16*lambda^2)<1/(8*lambda^2)
locked_formulas.endpoint_recurrence: for k>=1, P_(k+1)=((mu-c^2-k*(k+1))*P_k-2*k*c^2*P_(k-1)-k*(k-1)*c^2*P_(k-2))/(2*(k+1)); at k=1 the P_(k-2) term is absent, equivalently P_(-1)=0
locked_formulas.endpoint_derivatives: y_n^(k)(1)=P_k(mu_n(c);c)*y_n(1), with leading coefficient of P_k equal to 1/(2^k*k!)
locked_formulas.endpoint_high_label_block: D_R*J_R tends to V_(K,a), where (V_(K,a))_(k,j)=epsilon_sigma*a_j^(2*k+1/2)/(2^k*k!), and a certified half-singular-value perturbation gives s_min(J_R)>=s_min(V_(K,a))*sqrt(R/lambda)/2
locked_formulas.jet_range_equivalence: for fixed lambda, fixed K, and fixed finite X, T(D_(sigma,K)^0)=T(D_sigma); endpoint constraints preserve an existing finite physical range but do not create rank
locked_formulas.odd_finite_matrix: Q_N=P_N*A_lambda*P_N-2*|p_N><p_N|, with the complete combined archimedean-minus-prime A_lambda
locked_formulas.odd_pole_coefficients: <phi_k,p>=2*i*kappa_k*sinh(log(lambda)/2)/(sqrt(L)*(kappa_k^2+1/4)), kappa_k=2*pi*k/L, and the k=0 coefficient is zero
locked_formulas.graph_convergence: for every fixed lambda>1, r_N tends to R=A_lambda*p-tau*p in L2 and ||b_N|| tends to ||R||/sqrt(mu)
locked_formulas.graph_error: g_N=||p_N-p||, h_N=||A_lambda*(p_N-p)||, q_N=||(I-P_N)*A_lambda*p||, d_N=(g_N*||A_lambda*p||+sqrt(mu_N)*h_N)/mu_N+|tau|*g_N^2/mu_N, and ||r_N-R||<=E_N=h_N+q_N+d_N*sqrt(mu_N)+|tau|*g_N tending to zero; all actions use the complete combined multiplier
locked_formulas.jump_band_law: |k|^2*|F_k|^2 tends to L*J_(lambda,n)^2/(4*pi^2), and K*||(P_(2K)-P_K)F||^2 tends to L*J_(lambda,n)^2/(4*pi^2)
locked_formulas.finite_cross_lower: for M>=2*K, sqrt(mu_M)*||b_M||>=(1-eta)*J_(lambda,n)*sqrt(L/(8*pi^2*K))-E_M; the positive lower bound additionally requires E_M at most one half of the displayed jump term
locked_formulas.finite_jump_transfer: for each fixed locked lambda, b_M is nonzero for every sufficiently large M; no uniform M(lambda) is supplied
locked_formulas.krylov_moment_gate: nu_(beta,M)>0 and (alpha_M-beta)*nu_(beta,M)>sigma_M^4 are both mandatory before an inverse-load conclusion

claim_boundary.mixed_result: a total fail-closed mixed-prefix schedule and explicit source-normalized floor for each finite computable target, plus a coarse parameter-explicit BV majorant; not a useful transition-scale asymptotic schedule
claim_boundary.endpoint_result: fixed-parameter endpoint recurrence, high-label jet correction, jet-zero density, and range equivalence; not a new prescribed coframe or common diagonal
claim_boundary.odd_result: fixed-parameter graph convergence and eventual nonzero finite cross vector, with a localized jump-band law; not a transverse floor, positive moment gate, or inverse-load enclosure
